decision.reason: EPR-02 and EPR-03 have local pilot-equivalent evidence, but controlled target evidence, real alert acknowledgement, rollback boundary, communication route, and owner signatures are missing.

gates.title: Attach fresh pilot release evidence.
gates.summary: Payload-safe local release evidence is attached for benchmark gate, live agent-contract smoke, governance/compliance smoke, backup/restore validation, and alert artifact validation.

gates.title: Sign the external-pilot go/no-go record.

gates.title: Reconcile external-pilot documentation truth.

gates.title: Extract release-readiness status contract.
gates.summary: Machine-readable readiness status and schema now centralize EPR gate names, statuses, evidence links, blockers, and next recommended work.

requiredToFlipToGo: controlled evidence prefix under release_evidence_bucket or equivalent immutable audit store
target-environment deployment smoke or platform equivalent
fresh benchmark scorecards for the intended pilot model and fixture set
governance/compliance smoke or platform equivalent against target database and evidence store
real alert receiver acknowledgement for the pilot route
signed rollback boundary and communication route
release owner and rollback owner signatures
